thread:
rachel: Heads-up — new hire Ethan (London) trying to finish I-9 style check but he's on UK right-to-work docs (BRP). Kiosk expects passport/US docs and is rejecting BRP scan. Start date next Wed.

sam: BRP should be acceptable as identity + right-to-work evidence for UK hires, but our portal is US-centric. We need a documented workaround.

nish: Agreed. Options: 1) manual intake by ppl-ops (we upload sanitized BRP), 2) schedule a short local in-person verification with our UK partner, or 3) ask Ethan to upload passport instead (he has one) if that helps.

bg-bot: background-check: DBS vendor requested certificate number for UK checks. If candidate has ongoing DBS subscription, vendor can match; otherwise have them complete the DBS form.

rachel: Ethan says he has a BRP and a passport but passport photo page is damaged (small tear). He can provide BRP + a selfie. Candidate also has a recent DBS certificate number.

sam: Good. Let's take BRP + selfie + DBS number. People-ops will manually ingest the BRP into the portal and mark I-9 equivalent for UK hires. Also need to note in audit: reason for manual ingestion.

people-ops-bot: action: create-audit-entry -> "manual-id-ingest: ethan-2660004444; reason: BRP accepted for UK remote hire; supporting docs stored in secure bucket; provisional access provided until final BG."

itbot: IT note — laptop shipping OK; timezone: London (UTC+0). We'll schedule onboarding call at 9:30am London to include global team. Will need a ticket for scoped provisional access (no prod) until BG clears.

rachel: Created ticket `onboard-uk-temp-2660004444` with 10-day provisional window. Security approved scoped access (no prod).

bg-bot: background-check: DBS certificate matched; vendor flagged a minor address mismatch for manual review — asking candidate to confirm address history past 3 years.

nish: DM Ethan to ask for the address details and confirm DBS subscription. Also send benefits enrollment link and local payroll forms (UK PAYE info).

rachel: Done. Sent message: "Please confirm 3yr address history and upload DBS cert + selfie (holding BRP). We'll process manual ID intake and provision non-prod access on day 1. Payroll forms attached."

people-ops-bot: calendar: Day-1 invite sent for Wed 9:30am BST; buddy assigned: nish. Closing thread unless vendor asks for more docs.
